skill_name: Write a narrative speech to promote a product.
workflow: Good morning! Have you heard about how amazing Sirius XM Satellite Radio is? With over 130 news, entertainment, talk and sports channels and commercial-free, you can be sure to find something to fit your mood. And every day, we continue to add new and exciting content to keep you in the loop on the latest entertainment, news and sports. So don't wait any longer, get Sirius XM Satellite Radio today and start experiencing the best in broadcasting.  Thank you!
